build_ex4bitlinear_layer: build a 4-bit quantized linear layer using Ex4bitLinear with GPTQ weights and optional bias
create_q4_matrix: create a Q4Matrix handle from qweight, qzeros, scales, and g_idx using ext_make_q4
run_q4_matmul: run matrix multiplication of a tensor against a Q4 quantized matrix using ext_q4_matmul
create_exllama_buffers: create temporary exllama buffers for act-order reordering and cuBLAS dequantization with create_exllama_buffers
set_cuda_device: set the global CUDA device for exllama kernel operations using set_device
